name: font_reload_vector_drop

ownership.argument: Builds zeroed 16-byte key with object at +4 and drops only that object from vector cache. Use at supported serialized idle boundary; adapter then invokes existing font-property refresh, not allocation-unsafe eager rebuild.
ownership.return_value: See restricted adapter use contract; no general public callable approval.

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP/IDA investigation in ../Canopus-Module-Resource-Hook/targets/xiaomi-band-11-4.100.155/font-reload-investigation.md; checked adapter src/font_reload_155.c and native probes. Integration independently fingerprinted AP windows and inspected selected Capstone instructions; see EVID-FONT-4155-001.

notes: Builds zeroed 16-byte key with object at +4 and drops only that object from vector cache. Use at supported serialized idle boundary; adapter then invokes existing font-property refresh, not allocation-unsafe eager rebuild. Experimental exact-target allowlist only, not public ABI promotion or device verification. GPU error/reset, framework restart and unknown owners remain unsupported.
